text:
lindsay: Quick check before RC2 publish: do we include the version-bump commit in the annotated tag or keep the tag pointing to the CI build commit? Cutoff is 8pm PT. Also who is on GH release + attaching wheels/docker? cc @dominic
cheng: I prefer tagging the CI artifact commit so the tag matches the produced artifacts. We can still annotate the tag with the changelog excerpt. :+1:
dominic: I can do the GH release publish tonight. Need the signed tag pushed and a stable artifact URL from CI. Who updated CHANGELOG.md? I don't see an entry for the model-prefetch feature.
sara: I added a short changelog line in PR #3124 but didn't do the version bump — left that to the release owner. Pinged the PR for review. @lindsay can you confirm?
lindsay: Confirmed — I merged the changelog PR into release/v2.3.0-rc2 earlier. Version bump is in branch release/v2.3.0 (commit abc123). Suggest: annotated tag v2.3.0-rc2 -> point to CI build commit def456. Release notes should include the changelog snippet and the known issue about the batcher latency regression.
release-bot: CI artifact uploaded: https://ci.redwood.internal/artifacts/2026/1789001200/build-rc2.tar.gz
Checksums: sha256:aaa111...544
matt: For docker, CI pushed staging image redwood/v2.3.0-rc2@sha256:bbb222... — include that digest in the release body so deploys reference the exact image.
dominic: I'll create the draft release and attach the tar.gz plus add the docker digest. After that do we keep the release as draft until morning for final sign-off?
lindsay: Yes keep it draft. Also add this short table in the release body: 'Tagged commit: def456, Version bump commit: abc123, Artifacts: https://ci..., Docker digest: sha256:bbb222...' I'll review at ~7:30pm PT.
ops-bot: Reminder: signed tag required for protected branches. Use: `git tag -s v2.3.0-rc2 def456 -m "v2.3.0-rc2 annotated"` and then `git push origin refs/tags/v2.3.0-rc2`.
sara: If we need a python3.11 wheel, I can re-run that CI matrix job now — shout if needed.
cheng: One more note: ensure CHANGELOG header follows 'Unreleased -> v2.3.0-rc2' so the release notes extractor picks it up cleanly.
dominic: Got it. Will push signed tag once lindsay gives final ack, then create draft with attachments. Thanks everyone — I'll ping when draft is up. :rocket:
